Safe Routes to School programs makes it safe, convenient and fun for children to walk or bicycle to school. Elementary and middle schools can receive funding through Delaware Safe Routes To School Program.

Find out how your school could benefit by reading the program guidelines and sourcebook.

  • Delaware Program Guidelines
  • Delaware Program Sourcebook
  • Resources for Starting and Maintaining Your SRTS Program
  • What can Safe Routes to School do for you?

Get it!

The Delaware SRTS Program, in partnership with Delaware Risk Watch and the University of Delaware Cooperative Extension's Community Traffic Safety Program, is pleased to introduce the new Delaware Bicycle Safety Booklet. This interactive coloring and activity booklet was developed for children in Kindergarten through the 3rd grade and features "Lily the Ladybug", created by Tanya Shelton. Illustrations by children in Delaware elementary schools are featured throughout.

For more information about Safe Routes to School, please visit the Federal Highway Administration Safe Routes to School website. 



Toll Free: (800) 652 5600
In Delaware: (302) 760 2080
Email: contact@example.delaware.gov
